description: Invoice intake for AP agents: PDF or image URL in, one decision-ready JSON out. Extracts text, number, total, dates and vendor contact, then runs an email risk check and domain lookup on the vendor and returns accept, review or reject with reasons. Heuristic triage, not bank verification. Price $0.012 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"invoice":{"number":"INV-1042","total":"$1,250.00","vendor_email":"billing@acme.com","vendor_domain":"acme.com"},"vendor_checks":{"email":{"verdict":"accept","risk_score":0},"domain":{"registered":true,"age_days":4021}},"verdict":"accept","reasons":[]}
